verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs say you can 'create your first agent with a single command,' which supports one-command scaffolding. Its build-with-AI tooling (MCP docs server, embedded docs in node_modules, llms.txt) helps a coding agent work with Mastra projects. However, the evidence never names the official CLI or template, never shows the command, and never shows a coding agent running it non-interactively. Missing for 10: the named scaffold CLI/template and its command syntax, evidence that it runs non-interactively for a coding agent, and independent hands-on corroboration.
